TC-07/S21.title: Visual lane on both task screens and the Send dialog: axe, phone widths, WebKit Copy Text
TC-07/S21.detail: Recorded for Quinn (P2, accessibility is our extra): both task screens have serious axe color-contrast (5 nodes: header subtitle, location text); the icon-only toggles are named only 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' (not which task), expose no aria-pressed/checked (done shown by strike-through/colour only) and are 20×20 px (<24); Copy Text / Send are 44 px tall; a 120-character task wraps, no horizontal overflow; the Send dialog has no serious axe issue. Copy Text read back: Chromium desktop/Pixel 7 = same text as the screen; WebKit (iPhone 15 profile) clipboard read is refused by Playwright's WebKit (NotAllowedError) — the WebKit comparison stays with S23 (real phone).
